issue.title: test_hint_mode_renders_timestamp_file_hints_before_body_hints fails: rendered turn omits the prompt.py file hint

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails every serial run, not only under xdist. Observed in sase tool run check 3acd4d900f214c6830bc663849aed9dd, then again with .venv/bin/python -m pytest on this single node on 092fd1db05, and earlier on a10a6c6035 with the scope-sweep diff stashed. The assertion wants '[3] src/prompt.py' in the rendered turn. The render is AGENT PROMPT "Launch from [3] at src/raw.py" plus AGENT CHAT "Final response body", with no prompt.py hint line. tests do not import sase.agent.scope_sweep. This is a different node and a different symptom from sase-1hy (that one is test_hinted_raw_prompt_moves_to_identity_and_keeps_its_markers adding a duplicate file hint). Discovered while landing sase-1i4, not from a child PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1i4 landing's just check reported this hint render failure as NEW. It fails serially on current master and on the tree with the scope diff stashed, so it is not caused by the agent-scope epic.

payload.entry:
RESOLVED sase-1i9 - TestAgentRawPromptHintMode::test_hint_mode_renders_timestamp_file_hints_before_body_hints (test_agent_display_raw_prompt_hints.py) passes. Evidence: phase sase-1qt.1 recorded the node passing on athena (single-node run) and on apollo inside the 118-passed after-run, with the prompt-selection fix sase d26baecb05 + sase-core 45c6a260 in place (apollo before-state of the same files: 7 failed / 23 passed); this closeout turn re-ran test_agent_display_raw_prompt_hints.py on the current tree with the other prompt-render, cache, git-lock and import-budget files (231 passed). Closed normally as related evidence, not as a seed.

FOLLOW-UP DISPOSITIONS (lander FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE, carried into this close): (1) sase-1qt.1 note 4 wheel-cache proposal DECLINED as a cache bug: cache key 86beb74a9a2d2d03ad7707e25660b915fd68d290bdf38141e327d120e4664d50 metadata names a CLEAN core b0a63dc3 (wheel sha256 9f33941aa12e...), which predates agent_prompt_select in 45c6a260, so the missing binding is expected; the cache refuses dirty trees and rechecks source identity after build, and no incorrect exact-identity hit was shown. (2) sase-1qt.2 notes 2 and 3 are ONE drain-accounting test-order issue (cold 9 failed/3 passed, 12/12 with sase.core.git_lock_facade preloaded), retained and routed as a DISCOVERED ISSUE to active global-state epic sase-j7 (.2/.4); no duplicate task was created. (3) The import-budget proposal (sase-1qt.2 note 3, referenced by notes 4/5) is RESOLVED as this epic's own integration work: cleanup contributed +3,036 eager bytes and clan navigation +2,269 against the unchanged 12,162,484 cap; fixed by deferring the agents_sync tree, now 11,893,483 bytes (epic note #3). Phase .3 proposed no follow-up; adjacent sase-15e and sase-15f stay separately owned and untouched.
